record: D1 T2 rev 2 (a2) -12 V evaluation, single admitted dispatch

post_run_localization.note: Read from the same artifact after the verdict; it does not change any rule outcome.
post_run_localization.cause: design error in the pre-registered window: BT2W, the complement of the reset tanh 0.5*(1-tanh((v(ennd)-1.0)*8)), is already about 670 kOhm at v(ennd)=1.76 V (gate 5e-6) against the ~830 kOhm t2m node (R_1 || R_2), so XT2B is forced high and t2o pinned from about 85 ms; the clamp never engaged, and the -12 V conduction onset is at 137.65 ms (v(ennd) 0.65 V)
post_run_localization.attempt1_contrast: attempt 1 BT2G used the same tanh in the ON sense in series with 499 kOhm and stayed effectively connected to v(ennd) about 0.3 V; rule 1 passed on t2/adv there
post_run_localization.leakage_and_vf: rule 6(b) margin +15.1 uV in every completed case (25 C rows up to 1 uA DT2K); hot/adv DT2C reverse peak 1.02 V, so the 3 pA row applied and no bias above 5 V overlapped the rule 6(b) window
post_run_localization.aborts: every abort sits at a known deck-stiffness event inside a vendor macro or deck gate node (d1-deck-stiffness-20261112.md): about 1.04, 2.0-2.14, 3.07, 62.45, 101.27, 157 and 246.9-247.7 ms

evaluation.scope: T2 rev 2 (a2 output limiter, sourced diodes) on -12 V under the revised rules; model only, not adopted
evaluation.d1: HELD (a -12 V only result does not close D1)

hot.basis: FJH1100: IR doubling every 7 C (PROJECT inference, no hot row); BAS116L: the guaranteed 80 nA TJ 150 C row held flat below 150 C (monotonic, inference)

dt2c_failure_ir.basis: linear fit of the rule 6(b) margin over the DT2C-only adv cases

limitations: FJH1100 (DT2C, D_L) over-temperature IR is UNSOURCED; this blocks adoption until sourced or bench-measured
BAS116L (DT2K): IR assumed monotonic in temperature, so the 150 C row bounds lower temperatures (inference)
BAS116L (DT2K): the 75 V IR rows applied at <= 1.3 V reverse bias (inference)
VF below 1 mA is typical (FJH1100) or extrapolated from maxima (BAS116L); each role has a VF-spread pair
neither diode has an LCSC ID; both are staged outside the inventory, not owner bundles
HOT_T_C 82.1 C is continuous contract load at the owner-confirmed 40 C ambient; the let-through-held state (99.4 C, DT2C IR 4.75e-09 A) is out of scope for the D1 criterion
